question: Which two protocols are used by the NFSv4 protocol? (Choose two.)
theory: NFSv4 is defined as an RPC-based protocol that runs over IP networks using TCP exclusively as its transport, unlike earlier NFS versions which also supported UDP; it is not tied to Ethernet or FCP framing at Layer 2, since NFS operates at the network/transport and application layers over any IP-capable link. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 10 - NFS Concepts)
